fixes.fix: Explained "The first was the establishment of the United Arab Emirates in December _____, with Abu Dh"
fixes.text: VERDICT: 1971. WHY: The UAE was formally established in December 1971, with Abu Dhabi serving as its initial temporary political and administrative capital. TRAPS: Do not confuse this with the 1973 addition of Ajman or later emirates; the founding date is strictly 1971. HOOK: Remember '71' as the year the Gulf federation began, not the 1970s oil boom peak. Exam trap: Questions often swap 'temporary' capital details with permanent ones; stick to the founding timeline.
